text: かいパンやろうの　おめい　へんじょう　ならず…

structure.jp: かいパンやろうの　おめい　へんじょう　ならず…
structure.en: the swim-trunks guy's clearing of his name did not come about...

patterns.name: 〜ず
patterns.explanation: ず is an older way of saying ない, and at the end of a line it sounds stiff, like a headline. へんじょう　ならず = 'clearing his name did not happen'.
